1890-cavalry.name: 1890 Cavalry
1890-cavalry.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor cavalry carbine. Fires single shots at medium range with high damage.

alert-trip-mine.name: Alert Trip Mines
alert-trip-mine.description: This portable tripwire mine releases firecrackers and a small flare, alerting others to its location. Comes in a pack of four.

ambidextrous.name: Ambidextrous
ambidextrous.description: Quicker reloading of matched pairs, and custom clip reloads for semi-auto pistol sets.

ammo-box.name: Ammo Box
ammo-box.description: This small portable Ammo Box partially refills your weapons' extra ammunition, including special ammunition types.

antidote-shot.name: Antidote Shot
antidote-shot.description: Instantly cures and prevents all poison effects for a long duration. Physical damage associated with poison attacks still applies.

antidote-shot-weak.name: Antidote Shot (Weak)
antidote-shot-weak.description: Instantly cures and prevents all poison effects for a short duration. Physical damage associated with poison attacks still applies.

bear-traps.name: Bear Traps
bear-traps.description: This portable foothold trap clamps loudly shut when its trigger plate is touched, inflicting bleeding damage on its victim. Comes in a pack of three.

beastface.name: Beastface
beastface.description:
Reduce reaction range of animals (doesn't affect Monsters like Hellhounds ).
CATALYST: Your Hunter will not be noticed at all by animals, and won't break Branches.

berthier-1892.name: Berthier 1892
berthier-1892.description: French made, bolt-action carbine. High power for its light barrel. Partial reloads are punishing.

big-dynamite-bundle.name: Big Dynamite Bundle
big-dynamite-bundle.description: A bundle of seven dynamite sticks, for when something really needs to be blown up.

blank-fire-decoys.name: Blank Fire Decoys
blank-fire-decoys.description: A decoy that imitates the sound of a gunshot on impact. Useful to distract and confuse enemies. Comes in a pack of six.

bolt-thrower.name: Bolt Thrower
bolt-thrower.description: Reduced reload time for Crossbows, Bomb Launchers, and Bomb Lances.

bomb-lance.name: Bomb Lance
bomb-lance.description: Bladed harpoon launcher, adapted to fire projectiles with a delayed explosive. Lethal at short range but cumbersome to reload.

bornheim-no-3.name: Bornheim No. 3
bornheim-no-3.description: German made, semi-automatic pistol. High fire-rate and velocity, and low recoil. Balanced by low power and wasteful reloads. Can be dual wielded.

bulletgrubber.name: Bulletgrubber
bulletgrubber.description: Recover unfired round when performing partial reloads.

caldwell-conversion-pistol.name: Conversion
caldwell-conversion-pistol.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Slow to reload, but reliable and accurate. Converted to fire cartridges. Can be dual wielded.

caldwell-conversion-uppercut.name: Uppercut
caldwell-conversion-uppercut.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Based on the Conversion, this fires Long Ammo for more damage, but kicks like a mule. Can be dual wielded.

caldwell-pax.name: Pax
caldwell-pax.description: Caldwell made, single-action revolver. Reliable, accurate, and sturdy. Once brought peace to the lawless west. Can be dual wielded.

caldwell-rival-78.name: Rival 78
caldwell-rival-78.description: Caldwell made, break-action shotgun with two barrels. High damage but high pellet spread, two-tapping gives it an edge.

cavalry-saber.name: Cavalry Saber
cavalry-saber.description: One-handed saber in use since the Civil War. Lightweight with good reach.

chaos-bomb.name: Chaos Bomb
chaos-bomb.description: Set of firecrackers that can be used to temporarily distract nearby enemies. Duration of about 30 seconds.

choke-beetle.name: Choke Beetle
choke-beetle.description: Choke Beetles are bred to find and track prey, giving Hunters a view from above. They have also evolved to explode into a cloud of suffocating gas, which they themselves are immune to.

choke-bombs.name: Choke Bombs
choke-bombs.description: The Choke Bomb exudes a gas that extinguishes any flames within its radius while active–as well as preventing new fires form being lit–and induces heavy coughing. Comes in a pack of two.

combat-axe.name: Combat Axe
combat-axe.description: Two-handed axe that swings slowly but splits skulls.

concertina-bomb.name: Concertina Bomb
concertina-bomb.description: Spring-loaded razorwire coil that unfolded violently when thrown. Shreds and entangles anything that tries to move through.

concertina-trip-mine.name: Concertina Trip Mines
concertina-trip-mine.description: This portable tripwire mine deploys a small concertina bundle perfect for blocking doors and windows. Comes in a pack of two.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.description:
Get a Health and Stamina boost when your team picks up a Clue or closes a Rift.
SOLO: Doubles the effects of investigating a Clue.

crossbow.name: Crossbow
crossbow.description: Crossbow that fires powerful bolts. Quiet at range, but cumbersome with a long reload. Bolts can be recovered and reused.

crown-king-auto-5.name: Auto-5
crown-king-auto-5.description: Crown & King made, semi-automatic shotgun. Dominates close range with high power and fire-rate, but has a strong recoil.

dark-dynamite-satchel.name: Dark Dynamite Satchel
dark-dynamite-satchel.description: A deployable bundle of dynamite sticks that are detonated remotely via Dark Sight. Can be attached to walls and floors.

dauntless.name: Dauntless
dauntless.description: Thrown explosives can be defused when interacting with them.

decoy-fuses.name: Decoy Fuses
decoy-fuses.description: Pack of Decoy Fuses that can be used to breach closed doors and window shutters. It can also imitate the behavior of a lit bomb and can fool your enemies into clearing a space. Comes in a pack of three.

decoys.name: Decoys
decoys.description: A bag of scrap metal and glass. When thrown the noise can be effectively used to distract or divert enemies. Comes in a pack of twelve.

derringer-pennyshot.name: Derringer Pennyshot
derringer-pennyshot.description: A small, light pistol tool that holds two Penny Shot Ammo rounds. Perfect in a pinch.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: Doubles the amount of Health restored by First Aid Kit.

dolch-96.name: Dolch 96
dolch-96.description: Ludwig Arms made, semi-automatic pistol. High power and fire-rate. When empty, can be reloaded with a stripper clip. Can be dual wielded.

drilling.name: Drilling
drilling.description: German made, break-action combination firearm with two rifle barrels and single shotgun underbarrel. Highly flexible.

dusters.name: Dusters
dusters.description: Brass knuckles worn on the hand for blunt and brutal punches.

dynamite-bundle.name: Dynamite Bundle
dynamite-bundle.description: A bundle of several dynamite sticks. Why only bring one?

dynamite-stick.name: Dynamite Stick
dynamite-stick.description: A dynamite stick that detonates with a massive blast after four seconds.

fanning.name: Fanning
fanning.description: Faster rate of fire when using one-handed or two-handed single-action pistols.

fire-beetle.name: Fire Beetle
fire-beetle.description: Fire Beetles are bred to find and track prey, giving Hunters a view from above. Upon death or command, they will burst into flames that burn everything they touch.

fire-bomb.name: Fire Bomb
fire-bomb.description: Flammable liquid in a glass container that bursts on impact. Spreads burning liquid over a large area

first-aid-kit.name: First Aid Kit
first-aid-kit.description: A bag of medical supplies that heal 50 health and stop bleeding. Can be used three times.

flare-pistol.name: Flare Pistol
flare-pistol.description: A small pistol for firing flares into the air, illuminating the area. Can ignite flammable materials.

flash-bomb.name: Flash Bomb
flash-bomb.description: Light bomb that requires a short priming for its mercury-based chemical reaction. The explosion is capable of blinding all in close proximity, even if their eyes are shielded or averted. Needs a short time to be prepared.

frag-bomb.name: Frag Bomb
frag-bomb.description: Frag bombs send lethal shrapnel over a large area, lacerating nearby enemies. However, unlike Dynamite, the blast is not strong enough to destroy doors or concertina wire.

frontier-73c.name: Frontier 73C
frontier-73c.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. A lightened Ranger 73, this trades convenience for a slightly reduced capacity.

frontiersman.name: Frontiersman
frontiersman.description:
Use Tools one extra time.
SOLO CATALYST: Use Tools two extra times.

fusees.name: Fusees
fusees.description: Handheld railroad flares used for illuminating dark areas and for signalling. Can ignite flammable materials. Comes in a pack of five.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.description: Killing Monsters restores a small amount of Health.

greyhound.name: Greyhound
greyhound.description: Sprint at full speed for a longer duration.

hand-crossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
hand-crossbow.description: Hand Crossbow that fires compact bolts. Quiet at range and convenient to carry. Bolts can be retrieved and reused.

haymaker.name: Haymaker
haymaker.description: Re-envisioned, single-action combination revolver with an additional shotgun barrel. A Long Ammo conversion of the LeMat.

heavy-knife.name: Heavy Knife
heavy-knife.description: The heavy knife is honed for close quarters combat, its iconic silhouette carves out its home in the American pantheon of armaments.

hellfire-bomb.name: Hellfire Bomb
hellfire-bomb.description: Flammable liquid in a glass container that bursts on impact and creates a massive fireball.

hive-bomb.name: Hive Bomb
hive-bomb.description: Poisonous wasps emerge from this bomb to terrorize anyone unfortunate enough to be in the area. However, it has no effect on monsters.

hundred-hands.name: Hundred Hands
hundred-hands.description: Increases the damage of a Hunting Bow and reduces sway while at full draw. Allows use of arrows in melee attacks.

hunting-bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting-bow.description: Hunting Bow that fires arrows a great distance. Perfect for stealth. Arrows can be recovered and reused.

iron-eye.name: Iron Eye
iron-eye.description: Remain in iron sights between shots when firing bolt-action, lever-action, and pump-action Weapons.

katana.name: Katana
katana.description: Two-handed, single-edged sword. Swift and sharp enough to pierce the sturdiest armor.

kiteskin.name: Kiteskin
kiteskin.description:
Significantly reduces fall damage.
CATALYST: Never die from falling.

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: An all-purpose tool and melee weapon that has saved many lives – and taken just as many.

knuckle-knife.name: Knuckle Knife
knuckle-knife.description: The savage knuckle knife is a roughshod specialization for close quarters combat, suited for both bludgeoning and brutal thrusting deathblows.

krag-m1894.name: Krag
krag-m1894.description: Springfield made, bolt-action rifle. High fire-rate and ability to top off are offset by lower damage than other rifles.

lebel-1886.name: Lebel 1886
lebel-1886.description: French made, bolt-action rifle. High magazine capacity, damage, and velocity are offset with a slow and wasteful reload.

lemat-mark-ii.name: LeMat
lemat-mark-ii.description: Re-envisioned, single-action combination revolver with an additional shotgun barrel. High capacity and strong at close range. Can be dual wielded.

levering.name: Levering
levering.description: Faster rate of fire from the hip (First aim stage) when using lever-action weapons.

lightfoot.name: Lightfoot
lightfoot.description: Vault, fall and climb ladders silently. Also reduces the sound of walking through Noise Traps.

liquid-fire-bomb.name: Liquid Fire Bomb
liquid-fire-bomb.description: Flammable liquid in a glass container. Burns on the surface of water. Internal steel balls cause it to burst on impact.

magpie.name: Magpie
magpie.description:
Receive three short effects when picking up a Bounty Token: Antidote, Stamina and Regeneration.
SOLO: Dark Sight Boost capacity and all Boost sources are doubled.

martini-henry-ic1.name: Martini-Henry
martini-henry-ic1.description: British made, single-shot breech-loading rifle. Can be quickly reloaded and offers good power.

medical-pack.name: Medical Pack
medical-pack.description: A portable medical kit that heals 100 health. Deployable in active health emergencies.

mosin-nagant-avtomat.name: Mosin-Nagant Avtomat
mosin-nagant-avtomat.description: Russian made, bolt-action rifle. Powerful, fast, and can be reloaded with a stripper clip. Modified with an automatic action and increased ammo capacity.

mosin-nagant-m1891.name: Mosin-Nagant
mosin-nagant-m1891.description: Russian made, bolt-action rifle. Powerful, fast, and can be reloaded with a stripper clip.

nagant-m1895.name: Nagant M1895
nagant-m1895.description: Nagant made, single-action revolver. Medium damage, with a decent muzzle velocity and capacity. Can be dual wielded.

nagant-officer-carbine.name: Officer Carbine
nagant-officer-carbine.description: Nagant made, double-action revolver. High fire-rate, muzzle velocity, and capacity at the cost of damage and reload speed. Extended stock and barrel.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description:
Using Dark Sight, revive a downed teammate from a distance. (25m)
SOLO: You can revive your downed Hunter. Triggers a Full Health Restoration upon revive.

nitro-express.name: Nitro Express
nitro-express.description: American made, break-action rifle with two barrels. High power, but limited ammunition, and damage drops over range.

packmule.name: Packmule
packmule.description: Receive an additional item when looting Hunters or opening Tool Boxes.

pain-sense.name: Pain Sense
pain-sense.description:
You can see nearby bleeding, poisoned and burning Hunters while in Dark Sight. Also applies to Beetle view. (150m)
CATALYST: Includes Hunters out of Stamina.

physician.name: Physician
physician.description: Reduce the time needed to bandage.

pitcher.name: Pitcher
pitcher.description: Increased throwing range for all items using the aim helper.

poison-bomb.name: Poison Bomb
poison-bomb.description: On detonation emits a persistent, deadly cloud. Anything that passes through or gets caught in the cloud will be poisoned.

poison-trip-mine.name: Poison Trip Mines
poison-trip-mine.description: This portable tripwire mine released a cloud of poison when triggered, disorienting enemies. Comes in a pack of two.

quad-derringer.name: Quad Derringer
quad-derringer.description: A small, light pistol that is easy to carry and conceal. Holds four shots. Twelve additional rounds carried.

railroad-hammer.name: Railroad Hammer
railroad-hammer.description: Two-handed Hammer, swings with weight and power.

recovery-shot.name: Recovery Shot
recovery-shot.description: A shot that restores a lost Health Chunk.

regeneration-shot.name: Regeneration Shot
regeneration-shot.description: A shot that continually restores health over a long duration.

regeneration-shot-weak.name: Regeneration Shot (Weak)
regeneration-shot-weak.description: A shot that continually restores health over a short duration.

resilience.name: Resilience
resilience.description: Your Hunter is revived with up to full health.

romero-77.name: Romero 77
romero-77.description: American made, break-action shotgun with single barrel. High damage, cost-effective, and tight bullet spread.

salveskin.name: Salveskin
salveskin.description: While alive, reduce all fire damage and stop burn speed and stop time from escalating.

scottfield-model-3.name: Scottfield
scottfield-model-3.description: Scottfield made, single-action top-break revolver. Performs well at medium range and can be reloaded quickly when empty. Can be dual wielded.

serpent.name: Serpent
serpent.description:
Using Dark Sight, interact with nearby Clues, Rifts, banishable Targets and abandoned Bounty Tokens. (25m) Applies to Beetle View, except for Bounty Token interactions.
SOLO: Interaction range increased. (50m)

silent-killer.name: Silent Killer
silent-killer.description: Reduce noise when performing melee attacks.

slate.name: Slate
slate.description: Winfield made, pump-action shotgun. High damage and fast cycle rate, with high pellet spread.

sparks-lrr.name: Sparks
sparks-lrr.description: Big-game, single-shot rifle. High power and very effective at range, but cumbersome. Can put down a bison across a prairie.

sparks-pistol.name: Sparks Pistol
sparks-pistol.description: Single-shot rifle, cut down into a small handgun. Equally powerful up to mid-range, and convenient to handle. Increased recoil. Can be dual wielded.

specter-1882.name: Specter 1882
specter-1882.description: Specter made, pump-action shotgun. Tight pellet spread and competitive rate of fire, but wasteful reloads.

springfield-1866.name: Springfield 1866
springfield-1866.description: Springfield made, breech-loading trapdoor rifle. Fires single shots and is effective at long range.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.description: A monocular optical instrument for seeing things far away as if they were nearby

stalker-beetle.name: Stalker Beetle
stalker-beetle.description: Stalker Beetles are bred to find and track prey, giving Hunters a view from above. As a last resort, they can sacrifice themselves to cause a small explosion, hampering anything caught in the radius.

stamina-shot.name: Stamina Shot
stamina-shot.description: A shot which immediately restores all stamina and stops further depletion for a long duration.

stamina-shot-weak.name: Stamina Shot (Weak)
stamina-shot-weak.description: A shot which immediately restores all stamina and stops further depletion for a short duration..

steady-aim.name: Steady Aim
steady-aim.description: Gradually lessen weapon sway when looking through a scope or Aperture sights.

sticky-bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
sticky-bomb.description: Dynamite charge in a sticky frame that can be attached to objects and enemies. Its eight-second fuse doubles the detonation time of a dynamite stick.

throwing-axes.name: Throwing Axes
throwing-axes.description: Silent and deadly short-ranged projectile weapon. Can be retrieved and reused. Comes in a pack of two.

throwing-knives.name: Throwing Knives
throwing-knives.description: Silent, but short-ranged projectile weapon. Thrown knives can be retrieved and reused. Comes in a pack of eight.

throwing-spear.name: Throwing Spear
throwing-spear.description: Two-handed melee weapon, also balanced for throwing straight and true. Can be retrieved and reused. You'll receive one, be careful how you use it.

tool-box.name: Tool Box
tool-box.description: A portable toolkit that refills some dwindling supplies in a tight spot.

vetterli-71-karabiner.name: Vetterli 71
vetterli-71-karabiner.description: Swiss made, bolt-action carbine. Powerful at medium distances, and easy to reload. Balances ease of use with damage.

vigilant.name: Vigilant
vigilant.description:
While using Dark Sight, nearby Traps and active Beetles are highlighted. Also applies to Beetle View. (25m)
CATALYST: Double the highlighted range in Dark Sight.

vitality-shot.name: Vitality Shot
vitality-shot.description: A shot which immediately restores all health.

vitality-shot-weak.name: Vitality Shot (Weak)
vitality-shot-weak.description: A shot which immediately restores 75 health.

vulture.name: Vulture
vulture.description: Looting a Hunter will always reward you money.

waxed-dynamite-stick.name: Waxed Dynamite Stick
waxed-dynamite-stick.description: A dynamite stick with a modified powder fuse that enables detonation under water and in choke bomb clouds.

winfield-1876-centennial.name: Centennial
winfield-1876-centennial.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High muzzle velocity and good damage at range.

winfield-m1873.name: Ranger 73
winfield-m1873.description: Winfield made, lever-action repeating rifle. High fire-rate, large magazine, easy reload, and good handling.
